# Daventertainment Inc — David Cox

> Portfolio of David Cox, a full stack engineer and AI integration specialist based in Tustin, California, with over 20 years of experience, and founder of Daventertainment Inc (incorporated 2016), a sound design and web development company. He builds Next.js applications, SaaS platforms, e-commerce integrations and AI systems (agents, LLMs, RAG), and also produces music, art and video. Available for contract projects and full-time roles.

## Key facts

- Specialties: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, AI integration (Anthropic Claude, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, LangChain), SEO and AEO (answer engine optimization), Google Cloud analytics (BigQuery, Looker Studio, GA4), e-commerce (Shopify, BigCommerce, HubSpot, NetSuite)
- Career: started coding and digital video in 1997 through music; web development from 2000; contract web and SaaS development from 2005; founded Daventertainment Inc in 2016; a sales app he built was adopted nationwide by a logistics company's sales team in 2018; AI integration and commerce engineering since 2021
- Teaching: Teaching Director Assistant, UC Irvine Continuing Education full-stack MERN coding bootcamp (2019–2024)
- Education: Full-Stack MERN Developer Certification, University of California, Irvine (2019)

## Featured work

- [PageScore: AI SEO & AEO Audit Engine](https://daventertainment.com/work/pagescore): AI-powered landing page audits for search and AI engine visibility; over 10,000 active users. Live at https://page-score.com
- [Conversational Analytics Engine](https://daventertainment.com/work/conversational-analytics): GCP environment connecting BigQuery and Looker Studio to GA4 data; automated 85% of reporting
- [Bundle Builder](https://daventertainment.com/work/bundle-builder): AI-assisted shopping assistant for The Joy Factory that recommends a bundled case, mounts and accessories
- [Gamified Sales Engine](https://daventertainment.com/work/gamified-sales-engine): gamified SaaS sales platform that scaled to nationwide use at a national logistics company (under NDA)
